function feedback(value:TargetPracticeSubmission,record:ReturnType<typeof original>){
 const {packet,problem}=record,checked=checkTargetAnswer(packet.draft,problem,value.answer),c=problem.challenge,fence='`'.repeat(Math.max(3,...(value.reasoning.match(/`+/g)??[]).map(run=>run.length+1)));
 return `Target-outcome practice: ${packet.draft.title}\n\nHypothetical target calculated from the exact reviewed formula. Earlier exposure is unknown. The twelve-sample generator is not an inverse solver or a proof of unique answers. This is not a simulator or a measure of mastery.\n\nFind an input for ${c.variable} (${c.inputUnit}) between ${c.minimum} and ${c.maximum}${c.integer?'; whole numbers only':''}.\nFixed known inputs:\n${Object.entries(c.knownInputs).map(([name,number])=>`${name} = ${number} ${packet.draft.spec.variables.find(item=>item.name===name)!.unit}`).join('\n')||'(No other inputs.)'}\nTarget output: ${c.target} ${c.outputUnit}\n\nYour first answer: ${value.answer} ${c.inputUnit}\nYour first reasoning (retained, not graded):\n${fence}text\n${value.reasoning}\n${fence}\n\nCalculated output from your answer: ${checked.result.value} ${checked.result.unit}\nYour answer ${checked.matches?'meets':'does not meet'} the target within approximately ${Number(c.tolerance.toPrecision(8))} ${c.outputUnit}. Tolerance is the larger of 0.000000001 output units and one-billionth of the target magnitude; floating-point arithmetic is used.\n\nOne sampled input that meets the target: ${problem.witness} ${c.inputUnit}. Other valid inputs may also meet the target. Only the saved defaults and up to two current comparison outputs were excluded by this generator. Other earlier exposure remains unknown.\n\nUser-supplied assumptions:\n${packet.draft.spec.assumptions.map(item=>'- '+item).join('\n')}\n\nTechnical provenance:\nExperiment identity: ${value.basis.artifactId}; revision ${value.basis.revision}; digest ${value.basis.digest}\nSubmission receipt v1: ${targetSubmissionIdentity(value)}\n\n${sourceFormulaCitationText(packet)}`;
}
